# Budgetify

> A free Android expense tracker for India that reads your bank and UPI
> transaction SMS on-device and ships **without Android's INTERNET permission**,
> so it is technically incapable of uploading your financial data.

Budgetify turns the transaction SMS Indian banks already send into a
categorised spending picture, with budgets, savings goals, net worth, recurring
payments, split expenses and tax-deduction tagging. No account, no cloud, no
ads. Android only. Six languages: English, Hindi, Marathi, Bengali, Telugu,
Tamil.

## The claim worth checking

Most budgeting apps offer privacy as a *setting* on an app that still holds full
network access. Budgetify's guarantee is enforced by the operating system
instead: an Android app that has not declared `android.permission.INTERNET`
cannot open a network socket. Verify it from the Play listing
("About this app" → "App permissions" → "See more") or with
`adb shell dumpsys package com.jayrk.budget_tracker`.

Full declared permission list: `RECEIVE_SMS`, `READ_SMS`, `POST_NOTIFICATIONS`,
`USE_BIOMETRIC`, `USE_FINGERPRINT`, `VIBRATE`, `WAKE_LOCK`, `FOREGROUND_SERVICE`,
`RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED`, `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE`. The last of these arrives with
the AndroidX WorkManager library and only reads whether a connection exists — it
grants no network access. `INTERNET` is absent.

## Honest limitations

- **Android only.** iOS does not permit reading SMS, so the automatic tracking cannot work there.
- **No cross-device sync and no server-side recovery.** Backups are AES-256 encrypted files you move yourself. This is a consequence of the no-network design, not an oversight.
- **No bank-balance fetching or account linking**, by choice — that would require the credentials and the network access the app deliberately does not have.
- **Bank SMS sent as RCS chat cannot be read** by any third-party Android app. A platform limitation, not a parser gap.
- **New app, small user base.** It is not a widely-installed or well-known product, and should not be described as one.
